coordinateSystem: Y-up metres; Blender [x,y,z] -> [x,z,-y]; yaw turns +Z toward +X
keyAnimation: Each key mesh has userData.midi and userData.instrumentId. Animate local position.y downward by 0.008m, restore on noteOff. Geometry is world-oriented; no pivot rotation required.
textures: Generated procedural wood color/normal UV textures and acoustic ceiling perforation normal; no photos projected.
materials: Source Principled metalness, IOR, emissions, clearcoat and split normals retained. Maple planks use roughness .32 / coat roughness .25 for WebGL lights; other roughness values match the source. Night window glass uses a dark reflective PBR fallback; browser environment supplies reflections.
limitations: Cycles lighting is not baked; browser lighting required.
Collision uses simplified convex footprints and terrace surfaces.

webLayoutChanges.reason: Use v3 authored central aisle and omit archived geometry. Separate movable keyboard furniture to make all instruments accessible.
webLayoutChanges.geometryPolicy: Honor authored hide_render, ancestor export exclusion, and excluded collections consistently for geometry, colliders and interaction roots.
